normative_plan: Audit at /tmp/pantheon-dependency-audit-20260927/REPORT.zh-TW.md; narrow implementation prerequisite extracted from LOOP-RECEIPT-INTEGRATION-CORRECTIVE-001; re-opened to resolve Codex2 review defects

implementation.summary: Scope existing twelve-loop receipt schema and durable store with explicit tenant_id and environment before producer/read integration. Preserves honest legacy unscoped rows without invented provenance, enforces zero cross-tenant leakage, isolates unscoped legacy reduction from scoped partitions, provides non-lossy 002 rollback and pre-003 source compatibility, and establishes fresh-process restart and rebuild equivalence.
implementation.current_fix: Forward migration 003 adds nullable tenant_id and environment columns to loop_receipts and twelve_loop_observations with NULLS NOT DISTINCT unique index. Fixed reviewer P1 defect 1 by enforcing exact partition queries (tenant_id IS NULL AND environment IS NULL for legacy; tenant_id = %s AND environment = %s for scoped) and fail-closed validation on partial scope, preventing legacy and scoped reduction mixing. Fixed reviewer P1 defect 2 by adding tested non-lossy rollback (rollback_to_002_schema_sync) which archives scoped rows to twelve_loop_observations_scoped_backup and restores twelve_loop_observations_pkey constraint, enabling pre-003 store operations without InvalidColumnReference or UniqueViolation, and automatically restoring scoped rows on re-migration. Fixed reviewer P2 defect 3 by adding a real child-process verification test proving fresh-process restart, multi-tenant/environment isolation, and rebuild equivalence.
implementation.regressions: PostgreSQL migration 002-to-003 upgrade and honest legacy row preservation, unscoped legacy reduction isolation from tenant receipts, non-lossy rollback to 002 and pre-003 source compatibility, fresh-process child-process restart and rebuild equivalence, multi-tenant streaming, cross-tenant collision rejection, out-of-order delivery with provenance fencing, and failed persistence error handling.
implementation.boundary: Scoped receipt schema, storage, and read models only; no hosted deployment, no production-data migration, no credential changes, no second store or projector.
implementation.rollback_plan: Execute rollback_to_002_schema_sync(): archives scoped rows to twelve_loop_observations_scoped_backup, drops scoped indexes, and restores twelve_loop_observations_pkey on (release_id, correlation_id, loop_id). Allows pre-003 store code to run without UniqueViolation or InvalidColumnReference. Forward re-migration 003 automatically restores all backed-up scoped rows without data loss.

verification.collection: Every listed batch was run in bounded foreground execution and terminal exit status was collected.
limitations: Parent LOOP-RECEIPT-INTEGRATION-CORRECTIVE-001 retains all genuine producer ingestion and mounted authenticated read wiring and 12-loop coverage.
No hosted deployment or live/capital-affecting write was performed; verification conducted against isolated containerized PostgreSQL 16.
